title: Choose the visual world
question: A calm, beautiful reading site, inspired by GOV.UK's plainness but not a copy. Keep the assigned direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Letter of introduction
options.lineage: a personal letter on engraved letterhead, with enclosures
options.thesis: The site is a letter of introduction, and each case study is an enclosure.
options.viewport: Letterhead with your name in small caps and an address block (Brisbane, availability, email), a hairline rule, then one calm serif paragraph and a numbered list of enclosures.
options.risk: It can read quaint if the letter idea leaks into the copy. The idea stays in the frame. The words stay plain.

raised.raise: One measure rules every alignment: letterhead, column, enclosures and footer all hang from the same left edge.
Fixed regions: the letterhead and column never move between pages. Only the body changes.
Every enclosure is the same plate: identical fact block, identical six sections, the same place every time.
Three type sizes only. Rank comes from position, weight and small caps, not from a ladder of sizes.
State is a mark, not a colour: the current page and availability are shown with typographic marks and words.
A true night page: dark mode follows the reader's system setting, set for reading rather than inverted.

options.label: Margin-note handout
options.lineage: scholarly handouts with sidenotes in a wide margin
options.thesis: Every page is a well-set handout, with the facts in the margin beside the story.
options.viewport: A large serif title and italic subtitle, a reading column on the left, and a wide right margin holding sector, role, dates and stack as sidenotes.
options.risk: Familiar: many engineers already use this look for notes and blogs. On phones the margin folds into the column.

options.label: Cyclorama dawn
options.lineage: theatre lighting on a curved backdrop
options.thesis: Pages pass from night to day as the visitor reads.
options.viewport: A black stage with a cobalt band rising behind the name.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark, theatrical bands fight a calm reading column, and hiring managers do not see themselves in a theatre.
options.kept: A true night page for readers who choose dark mode.

options.label: Drawcord cape
options.thesis: One pull turns a flat plane into structure.
options.viewport: A black semicircle with one gold cord.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to engineering or reading, and gold on black is not a reading ground.

options.label: Sixteen-colour screen
options.thesis: Fixed screen regions with a docked text window.
options.viewport: A pixel portrait with a bordered text window below.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a bitmap face and dithering ruin long reading.
options.kept: Fixed regions: the frame never moves, only content changes.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.thesis: Each case study as a plate at the same scale.
options.case: Fuses partly: consistent plates help comparison, but the botanical world means nothing to this audience.
options.risk: Cream and sepia is the default rut.
options.kept: Every enclosure is the same plate.

options.label: Destination blind
options.thesis: Content rides a roll of cloth courses under one window.
options.viewport: Green cloth with yellow condensed legends.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an operations-board idea, wrong for a reading site.
options.kept: Few type sizes; rank by position and weight.

options.label: Cutting bench
options.thesis: Sections strung on a perforated rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: orange on black owns a third of the screen and drowns the text.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a colour.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio, executed with care.
canonCard.viewport: A big headline about you, two buttons, and a row of project cards.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other contractor's site, by design.
